title: Clipped: spot the octopus on the reef

scenes.headline: There's an octopus in this shot
Lives only 12 to 24 months
scenes.body: Females die soon after their last eggs hatch.

caption:
Hidden in plain sight, then gone.

Octopuses can learn: they tell objects apart by sight, touch and chemical cues. Females often wall their dens with shells and stones.

Source: Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Clipfarming demo: a 45 s wild CC BY-SA dive clip (Kora27, Egypt) cut to three beats: hidden, revealed, moving, plus a fact card. Real format is high-risk with third-party footage (unoriginal/copyright); only OK with our own or CC-licensed media plus added context, as here.
